To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mechanical design of this magnet is feasible, and that the coil pre-stress can be maintained during the assembly and cool-down of the magnet..
the mechanical design is validated by measurements on a 140 mm long short model, which was assembled from real quadrupole magnet components and instrumented with capacitanc pressure transducers.
the mechanical design of a quadrupole model was tested, the coil pressure measurements were made and the coil modulus measurements were compared.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: (1) The mechanical design of quadrupole magnets.

the mechanical design and the validation of the mechanical design of a superconducting quadrupole magnet for the LHC project, with the aim to develop a magnet that will meet the stringent requirements of the LHC project.

the following topics: (i) the design of the coil pre-stress system; (ii) the assembly and cool-down procedure; (iii) the design of a mechanical short model; (iv) measurements of the coil pressure distribution and comparison with design values; (v) measurements of coil modulus and comparison with the design value; (vi) comparison of two techniques of modulus measurements; (vii) the design of yoke material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanical design is sound, and that the design parameters have been verified.
the mechanical design of a quadrupole magnet is validated experimentally by the short model measurements.
the mechanical design of our quadrupole is validated by the results obtained with the short mechanical model..
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mechanical design is valid, and the magnet assembly and cooling procedure can be performed with high accuracy.
the design and assembly of the short model has been successful.
the mechanical design of our superconducting insertion quadru-pole magnet has been validated experiment-ally by measurements on this short model.

the mechanical design of this magnet is robust and the mechanical properties of the materials can be accurately determined.
